mechanism: stationary two-state Markov signs; one existing mechanism
independent_parameter_case_claim: 30 declared parameter cases; deterministic related trajectories, not statistical independent replicates

critical_parameter.decimal_computation: 50 significant digits; independent repeat at 80 digits
critical_parameter.parameter_roundoff_note: Algebraic expression is authoritative; Decimal approximation used only for finite trajectories.

fit_protocol.heldout: all valid integer n after each training endpoint through horizon
fit_protocol.leakage: Each fit receives training values only. Heldout signs do not determine exclusions.
fit_protocol.warning: Errors are deterministic approximation diagnostics, not p-values, confidence intervals or independent validation sets.
fit_protocol.free_power: Signed amplitude times n^power; log fit only on nonzero, sign-consistent training data; heldout sign changes remain failures.

theory.gamma: odd n: -2; even n: undefined (zero variance)
